profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer / ML Engineer / AI Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with 15+ years of experience, who finds joy doing Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science and Solving Problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning
positions.description:
• Integration of LLMs with Database Cloud systems to provide assisted AI to the customers.
• Experimentation with LLMs to assist in the generation of SQL queries from natural language.
• Development of large scale distributed systems in the Cloud to provide cloud capacity assurance and forecast.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Distributed Systems · Large Language Models (LLM)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: • Development of large scale distributed systems in AI platforms to provide massive A/B testing and experimentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Machine Learning
positions.description:
• Modeling, featuring and tuning large scale Machine Learning models for recommendations and content quality.
• Development of Big Data processes and pipelines to handle global-scale amounts of information.
• Development of large scale recommendation systems impacting millions of users around the world.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Amazon is the largest Internet based retailer in the United States and the world, the company also produces consumer electronics and it's the largest provider of cloud infrastructure services.

Responsibilities:
• Design and development of large scale, sophisticated, fault-tolerant, distributed systems in Java, Scala and Python
• Design and development of Natural Language Processing systems.
• Big Data processing and productionization of Machine Learning models
• Design and development of features to be included in virtual machines using Linux based systems, databases, etc. Using C, procedural languages such as SQL, or script languages such as Perl and Python
• Design, planning and execution of tests and proofs of concept related to distributed control systems, database features (using SQL or PL languages such as PL/Perl), Network and Operating System capabilities, etc 
• Performing code reviews and feedback to the development work done by fellow developers
• Performing systems maintenance work, and designing, planning and execution of deployment plans 
• Creation of technical documentation, presentations and conducting meetings
• Solving miscellaneous problems that require the application of science and engineering

Notable achievements:
• Being part of the team that provides cloud services to hundreds of thousands of customers
• Creation of a third party integration system involving interactions with multidisciplinary teams and functionality orientated to serve a high number of transactions per second
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Machine Learning

positions.title: Senior Consultant | Senior NetSuite Developer
positions.description:
On July 2015 C9 Solutions was acquired by Grant Thornton Australia to provide Technology Consultancy and Cloud Solutions.

Responsibilities:
• Design and development of solutions for NetSuite (CRM, ERP and E-commerce platform)  through SuiteApp bundles
• Development of cloud and Web applications using JavaScript, JQuery, Angular, AJAX, JSON, DOM, HTML, REST, SOAP, etc.
• Development and deploying of solutions/applications over AWS environments, including systems administration
• Implementation of cross-system integrations and development of integration APIs 
• Application of Science and engineering to create solutions for miscellaneous environments (among them Windows, Mac and Linux)

Notable achievements:
• Conception of business solutions/apps for NetSuite, for: Risk Management, Compliance Management and Third-Party Integration.

positions.title: Senior Applications Developer | Senior NetSuite Developer
positions.description:
C9 Solutions is a team of business & technology consultants dedicated to provide Cloud Solutions focussed in assisting organisations to consistently achieve industry leading business results, and strategic goals & grow.
C9 solutions merged with Grant Thornton Australia on July 2015.

Responsibilities:
• Development of cloud and Web applications using JavaScript, JQuery, Angular, AJAX, JSON, DOM, HTML, REST, SOAP, etc.
• Design and development of solutions for NetSuite (CRM, ERP and E-commerce platform)  through SuiteApp bundles
• Development of native mobile applications for iOS (Objective-C) and Android (Java), and cross-platform applications using Intel XDK 
• Development and deploying of solutions/applications over AWS environments, including systems administration
• Implementation of cross-system integrations and development of integration APIs 
• Development of Alfresco models and extensions using Java EE and XML
• Application of Science and engineering to create solutions for miscellaneous environments (among them Windows, Mac and Linux)

Notable achievements:
• Construction of the company's solid base of commercial products, comprising of a broad range of solutions/apps for NetSuite, among them: Risk Management, Compliance Management, Fundraising, Property Management, Billing Automation, Connections (Contacts'​ Networks), Intellectual Property Protection, Rostering, etc.
• Creation of libraries (in JavaScript) used in NetSuite Development to provide Multi-Thread Processing, Asynchronous Execution, Arithmetic of Arbitrary Length Numbers, Calculation of Date Periods, Execution's Resources Management, etc.
• Creation of mobile applications for iOS and Android incorporating OCR capabilities and cloud synchronisation mechanisms
• Achieving presence of the company in iTunes, Google Play and SuiteApp

company.name: C9 Solutions | Cloud ERP Solutions Provider

positions.title: Programmer/Course Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Developing course materials and tutorials for IT courses
• Participation in various IT projects including programming and software development
• General participation in the administration/marketing of the organisation
• Participate and conduct in various workshops

Notable Achievements:
• Conception of around 60 tutorials in four different programming languages: C#, Java, JavaScript and PHP

positions.title: Tech Lead Software Developer @ The Digital Library
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Development of systems in JAVA and Web applications using XML, XSLT, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
• Integration, training and leadership of development teams
• Development applications of information retrieval using protocols of Internet such as HTTP, Z39.50, OAI-PMH, SOAP, SRU and SMTP
• Development of tools to manage bibliographic records in formats such as MARC, MARC-XML and Dublin Core
• Development of multi-source and multi-thread search engines, in order to integrate heterogeneous sources of information
• Design and management of databases using SQL and database management systems such as PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle. 
• Development of searching and indexing applications using Zebra and Lucene
• Lecturing courses and coaching consultancies concerning issues related to Digital Libraries, Internet Protocols, XML and UML
• Implantation and maintenance of applications in Windows, Linux and Solaris environments
• Solving miscellaneous problems

Notable Achievements:
• Creation of the search engine of the Web site of the General Directorate of Libraries that integrates the electronic catalogs coming from heterogeneous sources (books, journals, articles, maps, etc). This has been efficiently served the academic community the university of more than 300,000 people
• Creation of a search engine freely available on the Web “OA-Hermes” that integrated electronic resources from open-access information sources around the world. It was used as a platform to broadcast the production of electronic resources of several international academic institutions (mainly Mexican and Spanish-speaking)
• Creation of Java libraries to handle Internet protocols such as HTTP and Z39.50, Session Management in Servlets, modeling structure of formats such as MARC and ASN.1 (BER), etc.

company.name: Science School, National Autonomous University of Mexico

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Lecturing courses for the curricula of the Bachelors of Science in Computer Science and Actuarial Science, among them: 
Database Systems, Database Management Systems, Introduction to Computer Science II (Data Structures), Programming I, Programming II, Operating Systems, Object-Oriented Analysis and Design

Notable Achievements:
• Collaboration in the formation of eight classes of computing professionals
• Successful integration of the use of technological tools off-class to improve the performance of the students

positions.title: Process Assistant
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Analysis and Programming of Web Systems using JAVA / J2EE, JavaScript and HTML
•	Programming end-user database applications using SQL, JAVA and PostgreSQL

Achievements:
•	Successful integration to a collaborative development team and gaining skills of interaction with the end-users
•	Mastering several technologies and languages involved in the development of Web systems

positions.title: Programmer and Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Analysis of data and generation of statistical reports
•	Programming of tools in JAVA, C++ and Visual Fox Pro for supporting the analysis of data

Achievements:
•	Successful integration into a multidisciplinary team and development of communication skills

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Programming of applications in Visual Basic for the automation of administrative processes and inventories
•	Extraction and analysis of information from Access databases
•	Generation of reports by using Crystal Report and Excel

Achievements:
•	Successful automation of several company’s processes saving great amounts of labor hours
